content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Professional employer organization and payroll outsourcing with workers' comp; it does not sell insurance policies as a broker."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Diversified holding company whose main businesses are billboards and broadband; insurance is only one minor segment."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Insurance brokerage placing personal and commercial policies with carriers for commissions, matching Goosehead's model."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Managed care and claims cost containment for employers and insurers; it does not place policies for customers."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced claims adjusting and settlement for insurers; it works on claims, not on selling coverage."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Licensed agents enroll consumers in carrier policies for commissions, though its products are health and Medicare rather than P&C."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Sells consumer insurance leads and referrals per lead; it does not place policies or earn commissions as an agency."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Mechanical, electrical and plumbing contracting for buildings; no insurance distribution."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Advertising and media agency serving brands for fees; unrelated to insurance brokerage."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Commercial and personal lines brokerage earning carrier commissions through producers and branch offices, closely matching the target."}]}
